docs.title: API — Intelligence & Delivery
docs.text:
This page documents the non-governance endpoints of the intelligence router (app/admin/intelligence_routes.py): scoring weights, agent configs, candidate signals and detected changes (including the feedback capture endpoint), competitor profiles, the LLM-backed query endpoint, delivery/digests, and the pipeline/Layer 2/scheduler triggers. The governance endpoints of the same router (proposals, policy packs, suppression/agent-policy rules, eval cases, NL command) are documented on the Feedback Governance & Policy Health page.

Every endpoint here is exposed under the /admin prefix. All handlers use body: dict (untyped) request bodies and return hand-built dict / list[dict] payloads — there are no Pydantic response_models on this router, so the field tables below are taken directly from the route function bodies.

No authentication

These admin endpoints have no auth dependency. Do not expose the router on an untrusted network.

Godrej Consumer Products grounding

The Layer 2 pipeline and its LLM prompts are grounded in Godrej Consumer Products (GCP) as the home company; monitored competitors are HUL, P&G India, ITC, Marico, Dabur, and Reckitt. This shapes the so_what / impact_assessment output surfaced by the detected-change endpoints and the answer produced by the query endpoint.

docs.title: Scoring Weights
docs.text: A single ScoringWeightProfile is active at a time. Creating a profile does not auto-activate it. The active profile's weights_json is merged over the built-in DEFAULT_WEIGHTS key-by-key at the top level.

docs.title: GET /admin/scoring-weights
docs.text:
List all scoring-weight profiles, newest first, flagging which one is active. Component: Scoring. Backing code: app/admin/intelligence_routes.py → list_scoring_weights().

Response — 200 OK → list of profile objects

Field Type Description id string (UUID) Profile id. name string Profile name. is_active bool Whether this is the active profile. created_by string Who created it. created_at string (datetime) | null Creation timestamp (stringified). updated_at string (datetime) | null Last-update timestamp. weights_json object The weight overrides for this profile. adjustment_log_json list[object] Audit log of weight adjustments applied to this profile. 
// Example 200 response
[
  {
    "id": "9f3c1e20-…",
    "name": "q3-tuned",
    "is_active": true,
    "created_by": "krishna",
    "created_at": "2026-07-01 09:12:04",
    "updated_at": "2026-07-05 14:22:10",
    "weights_json": { "category_scores": { "Pricing Change": 20 } },
    "adjustment_log_json": [
      { "adjusted_by": "analyst", "verdict": "under_rated", "reason": "pricing under-weighted", "at": "2026-07-05T14:22:10" }
    ]
  }
]

Status codes: 200.

docs.title: POST /admin/scoring-weights
docs.text:
Create a new profile. It is created inactive (is_active=false); call the activate endpoint to make it live. Component: Scoring. Backing code: create_scoring_weight_profile().

Request body — untyped dict; the route reads:

Field Type Required Default Description name string no "default" Profile name. weights_json object no {} Weight overrides (same shape as GET /admin/scoring-weights/defaults). created_by string no "admin" Creator identifier. 
// Example request body
{ "name": "q3-tuned", "weights_json": { "category_scores": { "Pricing Change": 20 } }, "created_by": "krishna" }

Response — 201 Created

Field Type Description id string (UUID) New profile id. name string Profile name. is_active bool Always false on create. created_by string Creator. created_at string (datetime) | null Creation timestamp. weights_json object The stored overrides. 
// Example 201 response
{ "id": "9f3c1e20-…", "name": "q3-tuned", "is_active": false, "created_by": "krishna", "created_at": "2026-07-08 10:00:00", "weights_json": { "category_scores": { "Pricing Change": 20 } } }

Status codes: 201.

docs.title: PUT /admin/scoring-weights/{profile_id}/activate
docs.text:
Activate a profile, deactivating every other profile in the same call. Component: Scoring. Backing code: activate_scoring_weight_profile().

Path parameters

Name Type Description profile_id string (UUID) Profile to activate.

Response — 200 OK

Field Type Description id string (UUID) Activated profile id. name string Profile name. is_active bool true. message string "Profile activated successfully." 
// Example 200 response
{ "id": "9f3c1e20-…", "name": "q3-tuned", "is_active": true, "message": "Profile activated successfully." }

Status codes: 200 · 404 profile not found.

docs.title: PATCH /admin/scoring-weights/{profile_id}
docs.text:
Merge weight updates into an existing profile and append a reason to its adjustment log. Delegates to app.intelligence.scoring_weights.update_weights(). Component: Scoring. Backing code: patch_scoring_weight_profile().

Path parameters

Name Type Description profile_id string (UUID) Profile to update.

Request body — untyped dict. Two accepted shapes:

Field Type Required Default Description weight_updates object no — Explicit map of weight keys → new values (old format). category_scores / tier_scores / any other weight key object no — New format: any top-level weight key not named adjusted_by/reason/weight_updates is collected into weight_updates. adjusted_by string no "admin" Who made the change (logged). reason string no "manual edit" Why (logged).

At least one weight update must be present or the route returns 400.

// Example request body (new format)
{ "category_scores": { "Pricing Change": 22 }, "adjusted_by": "krishna", "reason": "pricing signals were under-scored" }

Response — 200 OK

Field Type Description id string (UUID) Profile id. name string Profile name. is_active bool Active flag. weights_json object Merged weights after update. adjustment_log_json list[object] Full adjustment audit log. updated_at string (datetime) | null Update timestamp. 
// Example 200 response
{ "id": "9f3c1e20-…", "name": "q3-tuned", "is_active": true, "weights_json": { "category_scores": { "Pricing Change": 22 } }, "adjustment_log_json": [ { "adjusted_by": "krishna", "reason": "pricing signals were under-scored" } ], "updated_at": "2026-07-08 10:05:00" }

Status codes: 200 · 400 no weight updates provided · 404 profile not found (raised from update_weights ValueError).

docs.title: GET /admin/scoring-weights/defaults
docs.text:
Return the hardcoded DEFAULT_WEIGHTS dict (the baseline all profiles merge over). No DB access. Component: Scoring. Backing code: get_default_weights().

Response — 200 OK → the DEFAULT_WEIGHTS object

Field Type Description tier_scores object {Tier1,Tier2,Tier3: int} Points per competitor tier. category_scores object {category: int} Points per event category (10 categories). authority_scores object {source_type: int} Points per source authority level. corroboration_scores object {"1": int, "2": int} Points for 1 or 2 corroborating sources. corroboration_3_plus int Points for 3+ corroborating sources. novelty_new / novelty_update int Novelty bonuses. confidence_max int Max confidence contribution. penalty_rumored / penalty_weak_evidence / penalty_low_classification_conf / penalty_weak_snippet int Negative adjustments. score_high / score_medium / score_low int Significance-band thresholds. 
// Example 200 response (abridged)
{
  "tier_scores": { "Tier1": 20, "Tier2": 12, "Tier3": 6 },
  "category_scores": {
    "Product Launch": 18, "Pricing Change": 18, "Partnership / Acquisition": 16,
    "Geographic Expansion": 16, "Leadership Change": 14, "Technology / Infrastructure": 14,
    "Regulatory / Legal": 14, "Hiring Pattern Shift": 10, "Marketing / Positioning": 8,
    "Product Discontinuation": 12
  },
  "authority_scores": { "official": 15, "first_party": 15, "reputable_news": 10, "third_party_news": 8, "social": 4, "careers": 4, "weak_snippet": 1, "unknown": 0 },
  "corroboration_scores": { "1": 3, "2": 8 },
  "corroboration_3_plus": 12,
  "novelty_new": 8, "novelty_update": 3, "confidence_max": 10,
  "penalty_rumored": -15, "penalty_weak_evidence": -10, "penalty_low_classification_conf": -10, "penalty_weak_snippet": -5,
  "score_high": 75, "score_medium": 40, "score_low": 15
}

Status codes: 200.

docs.title: Agent Configs
docs.text: Per-agent prompt addenda and feedback used to steer LLM pipeline agents (AgentFeedbackConfig). Agents call get_prompt_addendum() at LLM-invocation time to append admin-supplied instructions to their system prompt.

docs.title: GET /admin/agent-configs
docs.text:
List all agent configs, ordered by agent name. Component: Intelligence. Backing code: list_agent_configs().

Response — 200 OK → list of config objects

Field Type Description id string (UUID) Config row id. agent_name string Agent identifier (e.g. classifier, scorer, impact_analysis, relevance_filter). is_active bool Whether the config is active. prompt_addendum string Text appended to the agent's system prompt. config_json object Structured config, e.g. {"examples": [...]}. feedback_notes_json list[object] Recent feedback notes (each {type,text,by,at}). updated_by string | null Last editor. created_at / updated_at string (datetime) | null Timestamps. 
// Example 200 response
[
  { "id": "a1…", "agent_name": "classifier", "is_active": true, "prompt_addendum": "Treat CSR press releases as low significance.", "config_json": {}, "feedback_notes_json": [ { "type": "instruction", "text": "Treat CSR press releases as low significance.", "by": "krishna", "at": "2026-07-02T11:00:00" } ], "updated_by": "krishna", "created_at": "2026-06-01 09:00:00", "updated_at": "2026-07-02 11:00:00" }
]

Status codes: 200.

docs.title: GET /admin/agent-configs/{agent_name}
docs.text:
Fetch one agent's config. Returns sensible defaults (empty strings/lists) when no row exists yet — this endpoint does not 404. Component: Intelligence. Backing code: get_agent_config() → app.intelligence.agent_feedback.get_agent_config().

Path parameters

Name Type Description agent_name string Agent identifier.

Response — 200 OK

Field Type Description agent_name string Echoed agent name. prompt_addendum string Current addendum ("" if none). config_json object Structured config ({} if none). feedback_notes list[object] Feedback notes ([] if none). 
// Example 200 response
{ "agent_name": "scorer", "prompt_addendum": "", "config_json": {}, "feedback_notes": [] }

Status codes: 200.

docs.title: POST /admin/agent-configs/{agent_name}/feedback
docs.text:
Add a feedback item to an agent. instruction/constraint are appended to prompt_addendum; correction/example are appended to config_json["examples"]. All types are recorded in feedback_notes_json (capped to the most recent N). Component: Feedback governance. Backing code: submit_agent_feedback() → app.intelligence.agent_feedback.submit_agent_feedback().

Path parameters

Name Type Description agent_name string Agent to steer.

Request body — untyped dict; the route reads:

Field Type Required Default Description feedback_type enum instruction\|correction\|example\|constraint yes — How the feedback is applied. feedback_text string yes — The feedback content. submitted_by string no "admin" Submitter identifier. 
// Example request body
{ "feedback_type": "instruction", "feedback_text": "Treat CSR press releases as low significance.", "submitted_by": "krishna" }

Response — 201 Created

Field Type Description id string (UUID) Config row id. agent_name string Agent name. is_active bool Active flag. prompt_addendum string Updated addendum. feedback_notes_json list[object] Recent notes including the new one. config_json object Updated config. updated_by string Submitter. updated_at string (datetime) | null Update timestamp. 
// Example 201 response
{ "id": "a1…", "agent_name": "classifier", "is_active": true, "prompt_addendum": "Treat CSR press releases as low significance.", "feedback_notes_json": [ { "type": "instruction", "text": "Treat CSR press releases as low significance.", "by": "krishna", "at": "2026-07-08T10:10:00" } ], "config_json": {}, "updated_by": "krishna", "updated_at": "2026-07-08 10:10:00" }

Status codes: 201 · 400 feedback_type missing, feedback_text missing, or feedback_type not in the allowed set (the underlying ValueError is surfaced as 400).

docs.title: DELETE /admin/agent-configs/{agent_name}/reset
docs.text:
Clear an agent's prompt_addendum and feedback_notes_json. No-op (still 200) if no config row exists. Component: Feedback governance. Backing code: reset_agent_config() → app.intelligence.agent_feedback.reset_agent_config().

Path parameters

Name Type Description agent_name string Agent to reset.

Response — 200 OK

Field Type Description agent_name string Echoed agent name. message string "Agent config reset successfully." 
// Example 200 response
{ "agent_name": "classifier", "message": "Agent config reset successfully." }

Status codes: 200.

docs.title: Candidate Signals & Detected Changes
docs.text: CandidateSignal is the Layer 1 output; DetectedChange is the Layer 2 output surfaced to analysts.

docs.title: GET /admin/candidate-signals
docs.text:
List Layer 1 candidate signals, newest first, with optional filters. Component: Scanning. Backing code: list_candidate_signals().

Query parameters

Name Type Required Default Description competitor_id string (UUID) no — Filter by competitor. status string no — Filter by signal status (e.g. candidate, promoted_to_layer_2_pending, archived). limit int no 50 Max rows returned.

Response — 200 OK → list of signal objects

Field Type Description id string (UUID) Signal id. competitor_id string (UUID) Owning competitor. source_id string (UUID) Source that produced the signal. source_type string Source type (e.g. website, news, careers). status string Signal status. relevance_score float Mapped from the signal's confidence. title string Signal title. url string | null First URL from evidence (url or first of source_urls). dedup_fingerprint string Dedup hash. created_at string (datetime, ISO 8601) | null Creation timestamp. 
// Example 200 response
[
  { "id": "c7…", "competitor_id": "hul-uuid", "source_id": "src-uuid", "source_type": "news", "status": "candidate", "relevance_score": 0.82, "title": "HUL announces new detergent line", "url": "https://example.com/hul-launch", "dedup_fingerprint": "3ab9…", "created_at": "2026-07-07T06:30:00" }
]

Status codes: 200.

docs.title: GET /admin/detected-changes
docs.text:
List detected changes, newest first, with optional filters. competitor accepts either a competitor id or a name substring (case-insensitive); if it matches nothing, an empty list is returned. Component: Intelligence. Backing code: list_detected_changes().

Query parameters

Name Type Required Default Description competitor string no — Competitor id or name substring. significance string no — Filter by significance (e.g. high, medium, low). status string no — Filter by change status (e.g. ready, archived, needs_reanalysis). limit int no 50 Max rows returned.

Response — 200 OK → list of change objects

Field Type Description id string (UUID) Change id. competitor_id string (UUID) Owning competitor. competitor_name string Resolved competitor name ("" if unknown). title string Change title. category string Event category. significance string Significance band. summary string What happened. so_what string GCP-relevant implication. recommended_action string Suggested response. source_urls list[string] Supporting URLs. confidence float Model confidence. status string Change status. event_cluster_id string (UUID) | null Backing event cluster. created_at / updated_at string (datetime) | null Timestamps. 
// Example 200 response
[
  { "id": "dc-101", "competitor_id": "hul-uuid", "competitor_name": "HUL", "title": "HUL launches premium detergent range", "category": "Product Launch", "significance": "high", "summary": "HUL introduced a premium detergent sub-brand.", "so_what": "Direct pressure on GCP home-care premium tier.", "recommended_action": "Review Godrej premium detergent positioning.", "source_urls": ["https://example.com/hul-launch"], "confidence": 0.88, "status": "ready", "event_cluster_id": "ec-55", "created_at": "2026-07-07 08:00:00", "updated_at": "2026-07-07 08:00:00" }
]

Status codes: 200.

docs.title: GET /admin/detected-changes/{change_id}
docs.text:
Full detail for one detected change, including its impact assessment and analyst feedback history. Component: Intelligence. Backing code: get_detected_change().

Path parameters

Name Type Description change_id string (UUID) Change id.

Response — 200 OK

Field Type Description id string (UUID) Change id. competitor_id / competitor_name string Competitor id and resolved name. event_cluster_id string (UUID) | null Backing cluster. title / category / significance string Core classification. summary / so_what / recommended_action string Narrative fields. source_urls list[string] Supporting URLs. source_signal_ids list[string] Candidate signal ids that fed this change. evidence_ids list[string] Evidence record ids. confidence float Model confidence. status string Change status. impact_assessment object See below ({} if none linked). feedback_history list[object] Prior analyst verdicts on this change. created_at / updated_at string (datetime) | null Timestamps.

impact_assessment object: id, summary, so_what, recommended_action, watchpoints (list), suggested_followups (list), extended_analysis (object), created_at.

feedback_history[] object: id, verdict, reason, analyst, applied (bool), status, created_at.

// Example 200 response (abridged)
{
  "id": "dc-101", "competitor_id": "hul-uuid", "competitor_name": "HUL",
  "event_cluster_id": "ec-55", "title": "HUL launches premium detergent range",
  "category": "Product Launch", "significance": "high",
  "summary": "HUL introduced a premium detergent sub-brand.",
  "so_what": "Direct pressure on GCP home-care premium tier.",
  "recommended_action": "Review Godrej premium detergent positioning.",
  "source_urls": ["https://example.com/hul-launch"],
  "source_signal_ids": ["c7…"], "evidence_ids": ["ev-9"], "confidence": 0.88, "status": "ready",
  "impact_assessment": {
    "id": "ia-7", "summary": "…", "so_what": "…", "recommended_action": "…",
    "watchpoints": ["Pricing of the new range"], "suggested_followups": ["Track distribution"],
    "extended_analysis": {}, "created_at": "2026-07-07 08:00:00"
  },
  "feedback_history": [
    { "id": "fb-1", "verdict": "over_rated", "reason": "regional only", "analyst": "krishna", "applied": true, "status": "processed", "created_at": "2026-07-07 09:00:00" }
  ],
  "created_at": "2026-07-07 08:00:00", "updated_at": "2026-07-07 08:00:00"
}

Status codes: 200 · 404 change not found.

docs.title: POST /admin/detected-changes/{change_id}/feedback
docs.text:
Submit an analyst verdict on a detected change. This is the main feedback capture / learning endpoint — a single call fans out to three subsystems:

  1. Legacy immediate path — records an AnalystFeedback row and applies structural side-effects via apply_feedback() (archive on false_positive, reset promoted signals to candidate on needs_reanalysis, URL suppression entries). Correction notes are pushed to the agents mapped to the verdict.
  2. Governance pipeline — FeedbackService.process_feedback() runs the same feedback through the proposal/policy governance flow (surfaced on the Feedback Governance page).
  3. LLM weight adjustment — for over_rated / under_rated / false_positive / missed with a non-empty reason, the score breakdown is loaded and an LLM decides which scoring weights to nudge via decide_weight_adjustments_with_llm() + apply_llm_weight_adjustments().

Component: Feedback governance. Backing code: submit_change_feedback(); orchestration in app.intelligence.agent_feedback.FeedbackOrchestrator.process_change_feedback().

Path parameters

Name Type Description change_id string (UUID) Change being reviewed.

Request body — untyped dict; the route reads exactly these keys:

Field Type Required Default Description verdict enum (7 values, below) yes — Analyst verdict. Validated against the allowed set. reason string no "" Free-text rationale. Required to trigger the LLM weight-adjustment path. analyst string no "analyst" Analyst identifier (note: the key is analyst, not analyst_name).

Allowed verdict values and their effects:

Verdict Effect correct Records feedback; no structural change. false_positive Archives the change + creates URL suppression entries; governance suppression-rule proposal; LLM weight adjustment (if reason). low_priority Records feedback only. over_rated LLM weight adjustment (decrease) if reason; governance proposal. under_rated LLM weight adjustment (increase) if reason; governance proposal. needs_reanalysis Resets promoted signals to candidate; marks the change needs_reanalysis. missed Records a false-negative; LLM weight adjustment if reason. 
// Example request body
{ "verdict": "over_rated", "reason": "This launch is regional only, not national.", "analyst": "krishna" }

Response — 201 Created. The body is the process_change_feedback() result dict, augmented in-place by the route:

Field Type Description change_id string (UUID) Echoed change id. feedback_id string (UUID) | null Created AnalystFeedback id (null if recording failed). weight_adjustment object | null Result of the weight adjustment. For LLM verdicts: {adjusted, profile_id, adjustments} on success, or {adjusted: false, error} on failure; for heuristic verdicts deferred to the LLM path this may read {adjusted: false, reason: "deferred_to_llm"}. agent_configs_updated list[string] Agent names that received a correction note. apply_notes list[string] Notes from the structural apply_feedback() step (present when a feedback row was created). 
// Example 201 response
{
  "change_id": "dc-101",
  "feedback_id": "fb-2",
  "weight_adjustment": { "adjusted": true, "profile_id": "9f3c…", "adjustments": [ { "path": "category_scores.Product Launch", "delta": -3 } ] },
  "agent_configs_updated": ["scorer"],
  "apply_notes": ["No structural action for verdict over_rated"]
}

Status codes: 201 · 400 verdict missing · 404 change not found · 422 verdict not in the allowed set of 7 (detail lists the valid values).

docs.title: Competitor Profiles
docs.text: CompetitorProfile holds an accumulated, patch-built profile_json per competitor.

docs.title: GET /admin/profiles
docs.text:
List all competitor profile summaries, most-recently-updated first. Each row merges DB fields with a computed summary from get_competitor_profile_summary(). Component: Intelligence. Backing code: list_competitor_profiles().

Response — 200 OK → list of profile summaries

Field Type Description id string (UUID) Profile row id. competitor_id string (UUID) Competitor id. patch_count int Number of patches applied to the profile. last_updated / created_at string (datetime) | null Timestamps. competitor_name string Competitor name (from summary). total_changes_tracked int Changes tracked in the profile. categories list[object] Per-category summary: {name, item_count, snippet}. 
// Example 200 response
[
  { "id": "p-1", "competitor_id": "hul-uuid", "patch_count": 12, "last_updated": "2026-07-07 08:00:00", "created_at": "2026-06-01 00:00:00", "competitor_name": "HUL", "total_changes_tracked": 34, "categories": [ { "name": "product_portfolio", "item_count": 8, "snippet": "Premium detergent sub-brand …" } ] }
]

Status codes: 200.

docs.title: GET /admin/profiles/{competitor_id}
docs.text:
Full profile_json for one competitor plus its 20 most recent detected changes. Component: Intelligence. Backing code: get_competitor_profile().

Path parameters

Name Type Description competitor_id string (UUID) Competitor id.

Response — 200 OK

Field Type Description id string (UUID) Profile row id. competitor_id string (UUID) Competitor id. competitor_name string Resolved name (falls back to the id). patch_count int Patches applied. last_updated / created_at string (datetime) | null Timestamps. profile_json object The full accumulated profile document. recent_changes list[object] Up to 20 recent changes: {id,title,category,significance,summary,so_what,recommended_action,status,created_at}. 
// Example 200 response (abridged)
{
  "id": "p-1", "competitor_id": "hul-uuid", "competitor_name": "HUL", "patch_count": 12,
  "last_updated": "2026-07-07 08:00:00", "created_at": "2026-06-01 00:00:00",
  "profile_json": { "product_portfolio": [ { "title": "Premium detergent line" } ], "pricing_observations": [] },
  "recent_changes": [ { "id": "dc-101", "title": "HUL launches premium detergent range", "category": "Product Launch", "significance": "high", "summary": "…", "so_what": "…", "recommended_action": "…", "status": "ready", "created_at": "2026-07-07 08:00:00" } ]
}

Status codes: 200 · 404 profile not found.

docs.title: POST /admin/query
docs.text:
Natural-language Q&A over competitor profiles and detected changes, via QueryService (prompt competitor_query v2). When competitor is provided the question is scoped to that competitor; otherwise the service either auto-detects a single competitor named in the question or runs one combined call across all active competitors that have profiles. Component: Intelligence. Backing code: query_intelligence() → app/intelligence/query_service.py.

Request body — untyped dict; the route reads:

Field Type Required Default Description question string yes — The natural-language question. competitor string no null Competitor id or name to scope the query. 
// Example request body
{ "question": "What pricing moves has HUL made recently?", "competitor": "HUL" }

Response — 200 OK. The shape depends on whether competitor was provided.

A. competitor provided (or the question clearly targets one competitor) → a single answer object:

Field Type Description competitor / competitor_name string Target competitor (or "All competitors"). question string Echoed question. answer string The LLM answer (never empty; falls back to a placeholder). key_events list[object] Each {competitor, event, significance}. sources list[string] Source URLs (LLM-selected, else collected from changes). confidence enum high\|medium\|low Answer confidence. gaps string Noted data gaps. 
// Example 200 response (competitor provided)
{
  "competitor": "HUL", "competitor_name": "HUL",
  "question": "What pricing moves has HUL made recently?",
  "answer": "HUL cut entry-tier detergent prices ~5% while launching a premium range …",
  "key_events": [ { "competitor": "HUL", "event": "Premium detergent launch", "significance": "high" } ],
  "sources": ["https://example.com/hul-launch"],
  "confidence": "high", "gaps": "No margin data available."
}

B. competitor omitted (broad query) → a wrapper object:

Field Type Description question string Echoed question. results list[object] List of answer objects (same shape as A; usually length 1 — one combined answer). count int len(results). 
// Example 200 response (broad query)
{
  "question": "Which competitors expanded distribution this quarter?",
  "results": [
    { "competitor": "All competitors", "competitor_name": "All competitors", "question": "Which competitors expanded distribution this quarter?", "answer": "Marico and Dabur both …", "key_events": [], "sources": [], "confidence": "medium", "gaps": "" }
  ],
  "count": 1
}

Status codes: 200 · 400 question is required.

docs.title: GET /admin/weekly-digests
docs.text:
List weekly digests, newest first. Component: Delivery. Backing code: list_weekly_digests().

Query parameters

Name Type Required Default Description limit int no 20 Max rows.

Response — 200 OK → list of digest objects

Field Type Description id string (UUID) Digest id. week_label string ISO week label, e.g. 2026-W28. status string draft / ready / sent / failed. subject string Email subject. change_count int Changes included. competitor_count int Distinct competitors covered. recipients list[string] Recipient addresses. created_at / sent_at string (datetime) | null Timestamps. 
// Example 200 response
[
  { "id": "wd-9", "week_label": "2026-W28", "status": "sent", "subject": "Competitive Intelligence — Week 28", "change_count": 6, "competitor_count": 4, "recipients": ["ci-team@godrejcp.com"], "created_at": "2026-07-06 08:00:00", "sent_at": "2026-07-06 08:01:00" }
]

Status codes: 200.

docs.title: POST /admin/weekly-digests/assemble
docs.text:
Assemble a new weekly digest from ready detected changes. Any existing draft/ready digest for the same week label is deleted first (dedup), then a fresh one is assembled. Component: Delivery. Backing code: assemble_weekly_digest() → app.delivery.digest.DigestAssembler.

Request body — untyped dict, optional; the route reads:

Field Type Required Default Description week_label string no current ISO week Target week label; defaults to YYYY-Www for now. 
// Example request body
{ "week_label": "2026-W28" }

Response — 201 Created

Field Type Description id string (UUID) New digest id. week_label string Week label. status string Digest status. subject string Subject line. change_count / competitor_count int Counts. created_at string (datetime) | null Timestamp. message string "Weekly digest assembled successfully." 
// Example 201 response
{ "id": "wd-10", "week_label": "2026-W28", "status": "ready", "subject": "Competitive Intelligence — Week 28", "change_count": 6, "competitor_count": 4, "created_at": "2026-07-08 09:00:00", "message": "Weekly digest assembled successfully." }

Status codes: 201.

docs.title: POST /admin/weekly-digests/assemble-and-send
docs.text:
Assemble a digest (with the same dedup behaviour as /assemble) and immediately email it. Recipients come from the request body, else settings.DEFAULT_RECIPIENTS. Component: Delivery. Backing code: assemble_and_send_digest() → DigestAssembler + EmailDelivery.

Request body — untyped dict, optional; the route reads:

Field Type Required Default Description week_label string no current ISO week Target week label. recipients list[string] no settings.DEFAULT_RECIPIENTS Override recipient list. 
// Example request body
{ "recipients": ["ci-team@godrejcp.com"] }

Response — 200 OK. Two shapes:

When no recipients are configured (nothing sent):

Field Type Description digest_id string (UUID) Assembled digest id. week_label string Week label. status string "draft". sent bool false. reason string "No recipients configured". change_count int Changes included.

When sent (or attempted):

Field Type Description digest_id string (UUID) Digest id. week_label string Week label. change_count int Changes included. status string Delivery-log status (sent / failed). recipient string Recipient recorded on the delivery log. sent bool true when status == "sent". error string | null Delivery error message, if any. 
// Example 200 response (sent)
{ "digest_id": "wd-10", "week_label": "2026-W28", "change_count": 6, "status": "sent", "recipient": "ci-team@godrejcp.com", "sent": true, "error": null }

Status codes: 200.

docs.title: POST /admin/weekly-digests/{digest_id}/send
docs.text:
Send an already-assembled digest to recipients. If recipients is empty, falls back to settings.DEFAULT_RECIPIENTS. SMTP error messages are cleaned to a compact SMTP <code>: <message> form. Component: Delivery. Backing code: send_weekly_digest() → EmailDelivery.

Path parameters

Name Type Description digest_id string (UUID) Digest to send.

Request body — untyped dict; the route reads:

Field Type Required Default Description recipients list[string] no* settings.DEFAULT_RECIPIENTS Recipient addresses. *Required only if DEFAULT_RECIPIENTS is also empty (else 400). 
// Example request body
{ "recipients": ["ci-team@godrejcp.com"] }

Response — 200 OK

Field Type Description digest_id string (UUID) Digest id. week_label string Week label. status string Delivery status (sent / failed). recipient string Recorded recipient. error_message string | null Cleaned error message, if any. sent_at string (datetime) | null Send timestamp. delivery_log_id string (UUID) Delivery-log row id. 
// Example 200 response
{ "digest_id": "wd-10", "week_label": "2026-W28", "status": "sent", "recipient": "ci-team@godrejcp.com", "error_message": null, "sent_at": "2026-07-08 09:05:00", "delivery_log_id": "dl-3" }

Status codes: 200 · 400 no recipients (body empty and no DEFAULT_RECIPIENTS) · 404 digest not found.

docs.title: GET /admin/weekly-digests/{digest_id}/html
docs.text:
Render a digest's stored html_body for browser preview. Returns text/html, not JSON (HTMLResponse). Falls back to <p>No HTML body.</p> when empty. Component: Delivery. Backing code: get_digest_html().

Path parameters

Name Type Description digest_id string (UUID) Digest id.

Response — 200 OK, Content-Type: text/html

<!-- Example 200 response body (text/html) -->
<html><body><h1>Competitive Intelligence — Week 28</h1> … </body></html>

Status codes: 200 · 404 digest not found.

docs.title: GET /admin/delivery-logs
docs.text:
List delivery attempts, newest first. Component: Observability. Backing code: list_delivery_logs().

Query parameters

Name Type Required Default Description limit int no 50 Max rows.

Response — 200 OK → list of log objects

Field Type Description id string (UUID) Log id. delivery_type string e.g. email. entity_type / entity_id string What was delivered (e.g. weekly_digest + id). status string sent / failed. recipient string Recipient address. subject string Email subject. error_message string | null Error, if any. attempt_count int Delivery attempts. created_at / sent_at string (datetime) | null Timestamps. 
// Example 200 response
[
  { "id": "dl-3", "delivery_type": "email", "entity_type": "weekly_digest", "entity_id": "wd-10", "status": "sent", "recipient": "ci-team@godrejcp.com", "subject": "Competitive Intelligence — Week 28", "error_message": null, "attempt_count": 1, "created_at": "2026-07-08 09:05:00", "sent_at": "2026-07-08 09:05:00" }
]

Status codes: 200.

docs.title: GET /admin/pipeline-health
docs.text:
Health summary of the intelligence pipeline over the last n_days, from FeedbackOrchestrator.get_pipeline_health(). Component: Observability. Backing code: get_pipeline_health().

Query parameters

Name Type Required Default Description n_days int no 7 Lookback window in days.

Response — 200 OK

Field Type Description period_days int Echoed window. total_changes int DetectedChanges created in the window. feedback_by_verdict object {verdict: int} Analyst-feedback counts grouped by (mapped) verdict. total_feedback int Total feedback rows in the window. active_suppressions int Active FeedbackSuppressionEntry count (global, not windowed). generated_at string (datetime, ISO 8601) When the summary was computed. 
// Example 200 response
{ "period_days": 7, "total_changes": 18, "feedback_by_verdict": { "correct": 9, "false_positive": 2, "over_rated": 1 }, "total_feedback": 12, "active_suppressions": 4, "generated_at": "2026-07-08T09:10:00" }

Status codes: 200.

docs.title: POST /admin/run-layer2
docs.text:
Manually run the Layer 2 CoreIntelligenceOrchestrator over queued candidate signals (status candidate or promoted_to_layer_2_pending), oldest first. Component: Control plane. Backing code: run_layer2() → app.intelligence.orchestrator.CoreIntelligenceOrchestrator.process_candidate_signals().

Request body — untyped dict, optional; the route reads:

Field Type Required Default Description limit int no 20 Max signals to process. competitor_id string (UUID) no null Restrict to one competitor. 
// Example request body
{ "limit": 20, "competitor_id": "hul-uuid" }

Response — 200 OK. Two shapes:

When no signals are queued:

{ "processed": 0, "errors": 0, "message": "No signals queued for Layer 2" }

When signals are processed (counters from CoreIntelligenceRunResult):

Field Type Description processed int candidate_signals_processed. errors int Number of failures. total_queued int Signals loaded for this run. archived int candidate_signals_archived. detected_changes_created int New detected changes. failures list[string] Failure messages (e.g. "signal:<id>:<error>"). 
// Example 200 response
{ "processed": 15, "errors": 1, "total_queued": 16, "archived": 3, "detected_changes_created": 5, "failures": ["signal:c7…:LLM timeout"] }

Status codes: 200 · 500 orchestrator failure (Layer 2 processing failed: …).

docs.title: POST /admin/scheduler/run-now
docs.text:
Trigger an immediate scheduler run (assemble + send the weekly digest). Delegates to the singleton WeeklyDigestScheduler.run_now(). Component: Control plane. Backing code: scheduler_run_now() → app.scheduler.get_scheduler().run_now().

No request body.

Response — 200 OK. Shape depends on outcome:

When recipients configured:

Field Type Description sent bool true when the send status is sent. digest_id string (UUID) Assembled digest id. status string Delivery-log status.

When no recipients configured:

Field Type Description sent bool false. digest_id string (UUID) Assembled digest id. reason string "no recipients". 
// Example 200 response
{ "sent": true, "digest_id": "wd-11", "status": "sent" }

Status codes: 200 · 503 scheduler module unavailable, not initialized, or does not support run_now().

docs.title: API — Observability
docs.text:
This page documents the observability router (app/admin/observability_routes.py), all served under the /admin/observability/* prefix and backed by app/observability/health_aggregator.py. These endpoints power the panel's observability screens: system and source health, pipeline runs, LLM metrics and cost, incidents, maintenance actions, the ops copilot, the pipeline board, live run state, timelines, cost breakdowns, and agent load. Almost every response here is a hand-built dict (there are no response_model schemas), so the field tables below enumerate the exact keys each function returns. Costs are reported in both USD and INR (USD_TO_INR = 85). All paths below are relative to /admin/observability.

Pipeline-board key format is load-bearing

In GET /pipeline-board, per-competitor stage_statuses are keyed workflow:stage (for example layer2:classification), and per-stage stats are keyed workflow:stage:agent_name. The panel JavaScript depends on this exact format. Do not change the workflow:stage key format — the stage comes from AgentRunTelemetry.stage, not agent_name.

docs.title: GET /admin/observability/system-health
docs.text:
Overall system health snapshot: per-component status, active issues, SLO indicators, and the last scan run. Component: Observability. Backing code: app/admin/observability_routes.py → get_system_health() → app/observability/health_aggregator.py → compute_system_health().

Response — 200 OK → hand-built dict

Field Type Description status enum healthy\|degraded\|critical Overall rollup. critical if any component is critical or a sev0 incident is open; degraded if any component is degraded or any incident is open. issues list[string] Human-readable problem statements accumulated across components. components list[object] One entry per subsystem (see below). Always five: Layer 1 Scanner, Layer 2 Intelligence, LLM Provider, Delivery, Feedback Governance. open_incidents int Count of incidents in status open or investigating. slo object SLO indicators (see below). last_scan_run object {id, status, started_at, sources_enqueued, sources_failed} for the most recent ScanRun (nulls/zeros if none). generated_at datetime (ISO 8601) When the snapshot was computed (UTC).

Each components[] entry always has name, status (healthy\|degraded\|critical\|idle), and detail (string), plus component-specific keys:

Component name Extra keys Layer 1 Scanner last_success_at (datetime|null) Layer 2 Intelligence signals_24h (int), changes_24h (int) LLM Provider calls_1h (int), error_rate_pct (float), tokens_1h (int), cost_1h_usd (float) Delivery sent_6h (int), failed_6h (int) Feedback Governance pending_proposals (int), false_positive_rate_pct (float)

slo object:

Field Type Description scan_success_rate_pct float|null Completed fraction of the last 10 scan runs. avg_scan_duration_seconds float|null Mean duration of completed runs in the last 10. llm_cost_today_usd float Estimated LLM cost since midnight UTC. false_positive_rate_pct float Analyst false-positive rate over 24h. pending_governance_proposals int FeedbackChangeProposal rows awaiting human review. 
// Example 200 response
{
  "status": "degraded",
  "issues": ["23.5% source failure rate in last run."],
  "components": [
    { "name": "Layer 1 Scanner", "status": "degraded", "detail": "Last run: a1b2c3d4 | Failure rate: 23.5%", "last_success_at": "2026-07-09T04:00:11Z" },
    { "name": "Layer 2 Intelligence", "status": "healthy", "detail": "Signals (24h): 142 | Changes (24h): 18", "signals_24h": 142, "changes_24h": 18 },
    { "name": "LLM Provider", "status": "healthy", "detail": "Calls (1h): 60 | Error rate: 0.0% | Tokens: 84,200 | Cost: $0.612", "calls_1h": 60, "error_rate_pct": 0.0, "tokens_1h": 84200, "cost_1h_usd": 0.612 },
    { "name": "Delivery", "status": "healthy", "detail": "Sent (6h): 4 | Failed: 0", "sent_6h": 4, "failed_6h": 0 },
    { "name": "Feedback Governance", "status": "healthy", "detail": "Pending proposals: 2 | FP rate (24h): 12.0%", "pending_proposals": 2, "false_positive_rate_pct": 12.0 }
  ],
  "open_incidents": 1,
  "slo": { "scan_success_rate_pct": 90.0, "avg_scan_duration_seconds": 412.3, "llm_cost_today_usd": 3.87, "false_positive_rate_pct": 12.0, "pending_governance_proposals": 2 },
  "last_scan_run": { "id": "a1b2c3d4-…", "status": "completed", "started_at": "2026-07-09T04:00:11Z", "sources_enqueued": 34, "sources_failed": 8 },
  "generated_at": "2026-07-09T06:15:00Z"
}

Status codes: 200 OK.

docs.title: GET /admin/observability/source-health
docs.text:
Per-source health scorecard (failure streaks, latency, candidate rate, recommended action). Component: Observability. Backing code: app/admin/observability_routes.py → get_source_health() → app/observability/health_aggregator.py → compute_source_health(). Filtering by status and competitor is applied in the route after the aggregator runs.

Query parameters

Name Type Required Default Description status string no — Exact-match filter on the computed status field (healthy\|warning\|degraded\|critical\|never_run). competitor string no — Case-insensitive substring match on the competitor name.

Response — 200 OK → list[object], sorted by descending failure streak then competitor name

Field Type Description source_id string (UUID) Source identifier. competitor string Competitor name ("?" if unresolved). source_type string e.g. website, news, careers, blog, social. url string Source URL. status enum healthy\|warning\|degraded\|critical\|never_run warning at streak ≥1, degraded ≥3, critical ≥5. last_success_at datetime|null Most recent completed scan (from started_at). last_failure_at datetime|null Most recent failed scan (from started_at). failure_streak int Consecutive failures from newest log. runs_sampled int Number of logs examined (≤10). Present only when the source has run (omitted on never_run). avg_latency_ms int|null Mean scan latency over sampled logs. candidate_rate float Mean candidate signals per run. error_type string|null Error type of the most recent log. last_error string|null Most recent error message, truncated to 200 chars. Present only when the source has run (omitted on never_run). recommended_action string Heuristic remediation hint.

never_run sources have a reduced shape

Sources with no scan logs return status: "never_run", failure_streak: 0, candidate_rate: 0.0, and omit runs_sampled and last_error.

// Example 200 response
[
  {
    "source_id": "77f0…",
    "competitor": "Dabur",
    "source_type": "careers",
    "url": "https://careers.dabur.com",
    "status": "degraded",
    "last_success_at": "2026-07-07T04:02:00Z",
    "last_failure_at": "2026-07-09T04:01:40Z",
    "failure_streak": 3,
    "runs_sampled": 10,
    "avg_latency_ms": 5400,
    "candidate_rate": 1.2,
    "error_type": "parse_error",
    "last_error": "Careers ATS returned unexpected markup near <div class=\"jobs\">…",
    "recommended_action": "Careers parser failing — ATS schema may have changed. Consider Playwright fallback."
  }
]

Status codes: 200 OK.

docs.title: GET /admin/observability/pipeline-runs
docs.text:
List recent Layer-1 scan runs with source-status breakdowns. Component: Observability. Backing code: app/admin/observability_routes.py → get_pipeline_runs() → app/observability/health_aggregator.py → compute_pipeline_runs().

Query parameters

Name Type Required Default Description limit int no 20 Max number of ScanRun rows (newest first).

Response — 200 OK → list[object]

Field Type Description id string (UUID) Scan run id. status string e.g. completed, running, failed. triggered_by string Who/what started the run. started_at datetime|null Start (UTC ISO). completed_at datetime|null Completion (UTC ISO). duration_seconds float|null End − start, 1 dp. sources_enqueued int Total sources enqueued. sources_completed int Total completed. sources_failed int Total failed. candidate_signals int CandidateSignal rows for this run. detected_changes int Always 0 — DetectedChange carries no scan_run_id, so it is not counted per run. stage_counts object {status: count} map from SourceScanLog, e.g. {"completed": 26, "failed": 8}. 
// Example 200 response
[
  {
    "id": "a1b2c3d4-…",
    "status": "completed",
    "triggered_by": "scheduler",
    "started_at": "2026-07-09T04:00:11Z",
    "completed_at": "2026-07-09T04:07:03Z",
    "duration_seconds": 412.3,
    "sources_enqueued": 34,
    "sources_completed": 26,
    "sources_failed": 8,
    "candidate_signals": 61,
    "detected_changes": 0,
    "stage_counts": { "completed": 26, "failed": 8 }
  }
]

Status codes: 200 OK.

docs.title: GET /admin/observability/pipeline-runs/{run_id}
docs.text:
Detail for one scan run, including per-source scan logs. Component: Observability. Backing code: app/admin/observability_routes.py → get_pipeline_run_detail() (hand-built in the route, not the aggregator).

Path parameters

Name Type Description run_id string (UUID) ScanRun.id.

Response — 200 OK → hand-built dict

Field Type Description id string (UUID) Scan run id. status string Run status. triggered_by string Trigger source. started_at / completed_at datetime|null Run bounds. duration_seconds float|null End − start, 1 dp. sources_enqueued / sources_completed / sources_failed int Source counts. source_logs list[object] Per-SourceScanLog rows (newest first, see below).

Each source_logs[] entry:

Field Type Description id string (UUID) Log id. source_id string (UUID) Source id. source_url string|null Resolved source URL. source_type string The adapter_name used. competitor string Competitor name (falls back to competitor id). status string Log status. duration_seconds float|null Log duration, 1 dp. attempt_count int Retry attempts. error_type string|null Error classification. error_message string|null Error text, truncated to 300 chars. raw_artifacts int raw_artifacts_count. candidate_signals int candidate_signals_count. llm_calls int llm_calls_count. started_at / completed_at datetime|null Log bounds. 
// Example 200 response
{
  "id": "a1b2c3d4-…",
  "status": "completed",
  "triggered_by": "scheduler",
  "started_at": "2026-07-09T04:00:11Z",
  "completed_at": "2026-07-09T04:07:03Z",
  "duration_seconds": 412.3,
  "sources_enqueued": 34,
  "sources_completed": 26,
  "sources_failed": 8,
  "source_logs": [
    {
      "id": "9d21…", "source_id": "77f0…", "source_url": "https://careers.dabur.com",
      "source_type": "careers", "competitor": "Dabur", "status": "failed",
      "duration_seconds": 5.4, "attempt_count": 2, "error_type": "parse_error",
      "error_message": "Careers ATS returned unexpected markup …", "raw_artifacts": 1,
      "candidate_signals": 0, "llm_calls": 0,
      "started_at": "2026-07-09T04:01:35Z", "completed_at": "2026-07-09T04:01:40Z"
    }
  ]
}

Status codes: 200 OK · 404 scan run not found.

docs.title: GET /admin/observability/llm-metrics
docs.text:
Aggregate LLM usage over a time window, grouped by agent (prompt name), from LLMTrace. Component: Observability. Backing code: app/admin/observability_routes.py → get_llm_metrics() → app/observability/health_aggregator.py → compute_llm_metrics(). Costs are estimated from token usage ($0.005/1K input, $0.015/1K output); this endpoint reports USD only.

Query parameters

Name Type Required Default Description hours int no 24 Look-back window in hours.

Response — 200 OK → hand-built dict

Field Type Description window_hours int Echoes hours. total_calls int Trace count in window. total_errors int Traces with an error message. overall_error_rate_pct float Errors ÷ calls × 100. total_tokens int Input + output tokens across agents. total_cost_usd float Estimated total, 4 dp. by_agent list[object] Per-agent rows, sorted by descending cost.

Each by_agent[] entry:

Field Type Description agent string Prompt name ("unknown" if unset). calls int Trace count. errors int Error count. error_rate_pct float Per-agent error rate. avg_latency_ms int|null Mean latency. p95_latency_ms int|null p95 (max if <20 samples). input_tokens / output_tokens int Token totals. cost_usd float Estimated cost, 4 dp. 
// Example 200 response
{
  "window_hours": 24,
  "total_calls": 420,
  "total_errors": 3,
  "overall_error_rate_pct": 0.7,
  "total_tokens": 1284000,
  "total_cost_usd": 8.9412,
  "by_agent": [
    { "agent": "classification", "calls": 180, "errors": 1, "error_rate_pct": 0.6,
      "avg_latency_ms": 1420, "p95_latency_ms": 2600, "input_tokens": 610000,
      "output_tokens": 92000, "cost_usd": 4.4300 }
  ]
}

Status codes: 200 OK.

docs.title: GET /admin/observability/llm-runs
docs.text:
Per-pipeline-run LLM cost summary. Uses LLMCostLedger (linked by pipeline_run_id) as the primary source, falling back to LLMTrace matched by the run's time window; the response indicates data_source as ledger or trace. Component: Observability. Backing code: app/admin/observability_routes.py → get_llm_runs() (hand-built in the route). Costs shown in USD and INR.

Query parameters

Name Type Required Default Description hours int no 720 Look-back window (default 30 days). Caps at 50 pipeline runs, newest first.

Response — 200 OK → hand-built dict

Field Type Description hours int Echoes hours. runs list[object] Per-run rows (see below). total_runs int Length of runs.

Each runs[] entry:

Field Type Description pipeline_run_id string (UUID) Run id. run_type string e.g. full, layer2. status string Run status. started_at datetime|null Start. duration_s float|null Duration in seconds, 1 dp. total_llm_calls int Prefers PipelineRun rollup, else computed. total_input_tokens / total_output_tokens int Token totals (rollup-preferred). total_cost_usd float Cost, 6 dp (rollup-preferred). total_cost_inr float total_cost_usd × 85, 2 dp. competitor_count int Competitors in run. error_count int Errors in run. data_source enum ledger\|trace Which source produced the per-agent breakdown. agents list[object] Per-agent breakdown (see below).

Each agents[] entry:

Field Type Description agent_name string Agent / prompt name. calls int Call count. input_tokens / output_tokens int Token totals. cost_usd float Cost, 6 dp. cost_inr float cost_usd × 85, 2 dp. avg_latency_ms / max_latency_ms int Latency stats. source enum ledger\|trace Origin of this agent row. 
// Example 200 response
{
  "hours": 720,
  "total_runs": 1,
  "runs": [
    {
      "pipeline_run_id": "5c8e…", "run_type": "full", "status": "completed",
      "started_at": "2026-07-09T04:00:11Z", "duration_s": 412.3,
      "total_llm_calls": 320, "total_input_tokens": 610000, "total_output_tokens": 92000,
      "total_cost_usd": 4.431200, "total_cost_inr": 376.65, "competitor_count": 6,
      "error_count": 1, "data_source": "ledger",
      "agents": [
        { "agent_name": "classification", "calls": 180, "input_tokens": 410000,
          "output_tokens": 60000, "cost_usd": 2.950000, "cost_inr": 250.75,
          "avg_latency_ms": 1420, "max_latency_ms": 2600, "source": "ledger" }
      ]
    }
  ]
}

Status codes: 200 OK.

docs.title: Incidents
docs.text:
Incident CRUD (Incident). Bodies are untyped dict, so missing required fields return 400, not 422. Resolving an incident auto-sets resolved_at.

The incident response shape (_serialize_incident) is:

Field Type Description id string (UUID) Incident id. severity enum sev0\|sev1\|sev2\|sev3 Severity. title string Short title. description string|null Details. status string open, investigating, resolved, closed, … component string|null Affected component. affected_competitors list From affected_competitors_json (default []). root_cause string|null Root cause. blast_radius string|null Impact scope. suggested_actions list From suggested_actions_json (default []). copilot_diagnosis object|null Stored copilot diagnosis JSON. scan_run_id string (UUID)|null Linked scan run. created_by string Creator. created_at datetime|null Creation time. resolved_at datetime|null Resolution time.

affected_sources is write-only

affected_sources is accepted and stored on POST, but _serialize_incident does not return it. It is absent from every incident response.

docs.title: GET /admin/observability/incidents
docs.text:
List incidents, newest first. Component: Observability. Backing code: app/admin/observability_routes.py → get_incidents() → app/observability/health_aggregator.py → list_incidents().

Query parameters

Name Type Required Default Description status string no — Exact-match filter on status. limit int no 50 Max rows.

Response — 200 OK → list[object] (each is the incident shape above).

// Example 200 response
[
  {
    "id": "0f2b…", "severity": "sev1", "title": "Dabur careers source failing",
    "description": "Parser errors on last 3 runs", "status": "investigating",
    "component": "Layer 1 Scanner", "affected_competitors": ["Dabur"], "root_cause": null,
    "blast_radius": "Dabur careers signals only", "suggested_actions": [],
    "copilot_diagnosis": null, "scan_run_id": "a1b2c3d4-…", "created_by": "admin",
    "created_at": "2026-07-09T05:00:00Z", "resolved_at": null
  }
]

Status codes: 200 OK.

docs.title: POST /admin/observability/incidents
docs.text:
Create an incident (status forced to open). Component: Observability. Backing code: app/admin/observability_routes.py → create_incident().

Request body — untyped dict; keys the route reads:

Field Type Required Default Description title string yes — Trimmed; 400 if empty/missing. severity string no "sev2" Severity level. description string no null Details. component string no null Affected component. affected_competitors list no [] Stored as JSON. affected_sources list no [] Stored as JSON (write-only — not returned). scan_run_id string (UUID) no null Linked scan run. created_by string no "admin" Creator. 
// Example request body
{
  "title": "Dabur careers source failing",
  "severity": "sev1",
  "description": "Parser errors on last 3 runs",
  "component": "Layer 1 Scanner",
  "affected_competitors": ["Dabur"],
  "affected_sources": ["77f0…"],
  "scan_run_id": "a1b2c3d4-…"
}

Response — 201 Created → the incident shape above.

Status codes: 201 created · 400 title is required.

docs.title: PATCH /admin/observability/incidents/{incident_id}
docs.text:
Update mutable incident fields. Setting status to resolved auto-populates resolved_at (once). Component: Observability. Backing code: app/admin/observability_routes.py → update_incident().

Path parameters

Name Type Description incident_id string (UUID) Incident.id.

Request body — untyped dict; only these keys are applied (each optional): status, severity, root_cause, blast_radius, component, description.

// Example request body
{ "status": "resolved", "root_cause": "ATS schema changed; parser updated" }

Response — 200 OK → the incident shape above (with resolved_at now set).

Status codes: 200 OK · 404 incident not found.

docs.title: Maintenance Actions
docs.text:
Maintenance actions (MaintenanceAction) follow an approval lifecycle: pending_approval → approved → executed. Bodies are untyped dict.

The action response shape (_serialize_action) is:

Field Type Description id string (UUID) Action id. incident_id string (UUID)|null Linked incident. action_type string e.g. disable_source, rerun_layer2, switch_provider, review_manually. description string What the action does. parameters object From parameters_json. status enum pending_approval\|approved\|executed Lifecycle state. risk_level enum low\|medium\|high Risk classification. auto_executable bool Whether it can auto-run. requested_by string Requester (admin, copilot, …). approved_by string|null Set when approved. result object|null From result_json, set on execution. created_at datetime|null Creation time. executed_at datetime|null Execution time.

docs.title: GET /admin/observability/maintenance-actions
docs.text:
List maintenance actions, newest first. Component: Observability. Backing code: app/admin/observability_routes.py → get_maintenance_actions().

Query parameters

Name Type Required Default Description incident_id string (UUID) no — Filter by linked incident. status string no — Filter by lifecycle status. limit int no 50 Max rows.

Response — 200 OK → list[object] (each is the action shape above).

// Example 200 response
[
  {
    "id": "b7a1…", "incident_id": "0f2b…", "action_type": "disable_source",
    "description": "Temporarily disable Dabur careers source", "parameters": {},
    "status": "pending_approval", "risk_level": "high", "auto_executable": false,
    "requested_by": "admin", "approved_by": null, "result": null,
    "created_at": "2026-07-09T05:10:00Z", "executed_at": null
  }
]

Status codes: 200 OK.

docs.title: POST /admin/observability/maintenance-actions
docs.text:
Create a maintenance action (starts pending_approval). Component: Observability. Backing code: app/admin/observability_routes.py → create_maintenance_action().

Request body — untyped dict; keys the route reads:

Field Type Required Default Description action_type string yes — Trimmed; 400 if empty/missing. description string yes — Trimmed; 400 if empty/missing. incident_id string (UUID) no null Linked incident. parameters object no {} Stored as JSON. risk_level enum low\|medium\|high no "medium" Risk. auto_executable bool no false Auto-run flag. requested_by string no "admin" Requester. 
// Example request body
{
  "action_type": "disable_source",
  "description": "Temporarily disable Dabur careers source",
  "incident_id": "0f2b…",
  "risk_level": "high",
  "parameters": { "source_id": "77f0…" }
}

Response — 201 Created → the action shape above (status: "pending_approval").

Status codes: 201 created · 400 action_type and description are required.

docs.title: PATCH /admin/observability/maintenance-actions/{action_id}
docs.text:
Advance an action through its lifecycle. Setting status to approved records approved_by; setting it to executed sets executed_at and stores result into result_json. Component: Observability. Backing code: app/admin/observability_routes.py → update_maintenance_action().

Path parameters

Name Type Description action_id string (UUID) MaintenanceAction.id.

Request body — untyped dict; keys the route reads:

Field Type Required Default Description status string no — New lifecycle status. approved_by string no "admin" Applied only when status == "approved". result object no null Applied only when status == "executed" → result_json. description string no — Optional text update. 
// Example request body
{ "status": "executed", "result": { "disabled": true, "verified_at": "2026-07-09T05:20:00Z" } }

Response — 200 OK → the action shape above (with executed_at and result set).

Status codes: 200 OK · 404 maintenance action not found.

docs.title: POST /admin/observability/copilot
docs.text:
Ops assistant. Assembles live context (system health, recent runs, 6h LLM metrics, problem sources, non-closed incidents, and any incident whose UUID appears in the question), asks the LLM for a structured diagnosis, and auto-creates a MaintenanceAction row for each recommended action (needs_approval: true → pending_approval, otherwise approved; no_action_needed is skipped, all requested_by: "copilot"). Component: Observability. Backing code: app/admin/observability_routes.py → maintenance_copilot().

Request body — untyped dict:

Field Type Required Default Description question string yes — Trimmed admin question; 400 if empty/missing. If it contains a UUID, the matching incident is surfaced into context. 
// Example request body
{ "question": "Why is Dabur careers failing and what should I do?" }

Response — 200 OK → hand-built dict

Field Type Description question string Echoes the input. diagnosis object The LLM's structured output (see below). actions_created list[object] One {action_type, risk_level} per auto-created maintenance action. context_snapshot object {overall_status, active_incidents, problem_source_count} summarizing the context used.

diagnosis object (validated against the copilot schema):

Field Type Description status enum healthy\|degraded\|critical\|unknown Copilot's assessment. likely_root_cause string Most probable cause. evidence list[string] Supporting bullets. blast_radius string What is / isn't affected. recommended_actions list[object] See below. answer string Plain-English answer to the question.

Each recommended_actions[] entry:

Field Type Description description string Action description. action_type enum (disable_source\|rerun_layer2\|rebaseline_source\|switch_provider\|purge_dlq\|pause_competitor\|rollback_policy_pack\|adjust_scan_frequency\|inspect_artifact\|review_manually\|no_action_needed) Action kind. risk_level enum low\|medium\|high Risk. needs_approval bool Whether the created action starts pending_approval. verification_step string How to confirm it worked (stored in the created action's parameters.verification_step). 
// Example 200 response (abbreviated)
{
  "question": "Why is Dabur careers failing and what should I do?",
  "diagnosis": {
    "status": "degraded",
    "likely_root_cause": "Dabur careers ATS markup changed, breaking the careers parser.",
    "evidence": [
      "3 consecutive parse_error failures on Dabur careers",
      "Other Dabur sources healthy",
      "No LLM provider errors in last 6h"
    ],
    "blast_radius": "Dabur careers signals only; other competitors and sources unaffected.",
    "recommended_actions": [
      {
        "description": "Disable Dabur careers source until parser is fixed",
        "action_type": "disable_source", "risk_level": "high",
        "needs_approval": true, "verification_step": "Confirm source is skipped in next scan."
      }
    ],
    "answer": "The Dabur careers ATS changed its markup. Disable the source and update the parser."
  },
  "actions_created": [ { "action_type": "disable_source", "risk_level": "high" } ],
  "context_snapshot": { "overall_status": "degraded", "active_incidents": 1, "problem_source_count": 3 }
}

Status codes: 200 OK · 400 question is required · 500 LLM call failed or returned an invalid/missing-field response.

docs.title: GET /admin/observability/pipeline-board
docs.text:
Full pipeline board for a run (resolved by pipeline_run_id, then scan_run_id, else the most recent PipelineRun): per-stage agent stats, per-competitor progress with stage statuses, and current run state. Powers the Live Run flowchart. Component: Observability. Backing code: app/admin/observability_routes.py → get_pipeline_board() (hand-built). Costs in USD and INR.

Query parameters

Name Type Required Default Description pipeline_run_id string (UUID) no — Resolve by pipeline run id (highest priority). scan_run_id string (UUID) no — Resolve by scan run id (latest matching PipelineRun).

If no run exists at all, returns {"pipeline_run": null, "stages": [], "competitors": [], "agent_stats": []}.

Response — 200 OK → hand-built dict

Field Type Description pipeline_run object|null Run summary (see below). current_state object|null Live state, or null if no CurrentRunState row. stages list[object] Per-agent stage stats, keyed workflow:stage:agent_name (see danger note). competitors list[object] Per-competitor progress (see below). total_agent_runs int Count of AgentRunTelemetry rows for the run.

pipeline_run object:

Field Type Description id string (UUID) Pipeline run id. run_type string Run type. status string Run status. triggered_by string Trigger. started_at / ended_at datetime|null Bounds. elapsed_ms int now − started_at in ms. duration_ms int|null Recorded duration. source_count / competitor_count int Scope counts. candidate_signal_count / detected_change_count int Output counts. total_llm_calls int LLM calls. total_input_tokens / total_output_tokens int Token totals. total_llm_cost_usd float Cost, 6 dp. total_llm_cost_inr float × 85, 2 dp. error_count int Errors.

current_state object (or null):

Field Type Description status string State status (falls back to run status). current_stage string|null Active stage. current_agent string|null Active agent. current_competitor_id string (UUID)|null Active competitor. progress_percent float|null Progress. sources_done / sources_total int Source progress.

Each stages[] entry:

Field Type Description key string workflow:stage:agent_name (e.g. layer2:classification:classifier). workflow string e.g. layer1, layer2. stage string Stage name. agent_name string Agent name. total / success / failed / running int Run-status counts. avg_duration_ms / min_duration_ms / max_duration_ms int Latency stats over runs with a duration. total_llm_calls int LLM calls in this stage. total_cost_usd float Cost, 6 dp. total_cost_inr float × 85, 2 dp.

Each competitors[] entry:

docs.title: API Overview
docs.text:
The Competitive Intelligence Aggregator exposes its entire control surface as a REST API served by a single FastAPI application (app/main.py). Every admin, intelligence, governance, and observability action performed in the admin panel is a call against one of the seven routers documented in this section. This page describes how the API is served, the router layout, the shared conventions all endpoints follow, and the error format returned on failure.

Because each capability is a plain HTTP endpoint, another team can reuse an individual component of this agentic-AI system standalone — trigger a scan, run the intelligence pipeline, ask a question, or send a digest — without adopting the admin panel. See Reusing components as building blocks below.

docs.title: Base URL & conventions
docs.text:
• Base URL: http://<host>:8000 (local development: http://localhost:8000). Run with uvicorn app.main:app.
  • Application: FastAPI, title Competitive Intelligence Aggregator, version 0.1.0 (app/main.py).
  • Content type: requests and responses are JSON — send Content-Type: application/json. Exceptions: GET /admin/weekly-digests/{id}/html returns HTML, and GET /health returns a small status object.
  • Authentication: none (see warning below).
  • Soft deletes: DELETE on competitors and sources deactivates the row (is_active = false) and returns 204 No Content rather than removing it.
  • Timestamps: ISO 8601 (e.g. 2026-07-08T14:32:00Z).
  • IDs: UUID strings.
  • Costs: reported in both USD and INR where applicable, using a fixed USD_TO_INR = 85 conversion.
  • Interactive docs: FastAPI auto-docs are enabled — Swagger UI at GET /docs, ReDoc at GET /redoc, and the machine-readable schema at GET /openapi.json. None are disabled in app/main.py.
  • Admin panel: GET /admin/panel returns the self-contained HTML panel (scripts/admin_panel.html). Every panel screen calls the same endpoints documented here.
  • CORS: permissive — all origins, methods, and headers allowed (CORSMiddleware with *).

No authentication

The API sends and requires no auth headers. It is designed for a trusted-network deployment only, and CORS is fully open. Do not expose it to untrusted networks without adding an authentication layer in front of it.

docs.title: How to read an endpoint entry
docs.text:
Every endpoint on the pages in this section is documented with the same fixed structure, so you can treat each one as a precise, standalone input/output contract:

  • Heading — METHOD /full/path/{param} plus a one-sentence purpose, the Component it belongs to, and the Backing code (app/admin/<file>.py → function).
  • Path parameters — table of {...} segments in the URL, with type and meaning.
  • Query parameters — table of ?key=value parameters, with type, whether required, default, and meaning.
  • Request body — the Pydantic schema (or the exact keys an untyped body reads), as a field table (type, required, default, description) followed by a JSON example.
  • Response — the success status and response model (or hand-built dict), as a field table plus a JSON example.
  • Status codes — only the codes that endpoint actually returns.

A subsection is omitted only when it genuinely does not apply (for example, no request body on a GET). Field names, types, and defaults are taken from the real route functions and schemas in app/schemas/admin.py and app/schemas/intelligence.py.

docs.title: Reusing components as building blocks
docs.text:
Each row below is a reusable capability of the system that can be invoked on its own via a single entry-point endpoint. Call the endpoint directly to use that component standalone; follow the reference-page link for the exact request/response contract.

Component What it does standalone Entry-point endpoint(s) Reference page Trigger a scan (Layer 1) Fetch + extract signals for sources POST /admin/scan-requests core-admin Run the intelligence pipeline (Layer 2) Cluster / classify / score / impact existing signals POST /admin/run-layer2 intelligence-delivery Ask a question (LLM Q&A) Natural-language query over competitor profiles POST /admin/query intelligence-delivery Test news relevance Dry-run the relevance gate POST /admin/competitors/{id}/news-profile/test-relevance schedules-news-profiles Preview news queries See the queries a profile would run GET /admin/competitors/{id}/news-profile/preview-queries schedules-news-profiles Submit analyst feedback Drive the learning loop POST /admin/detected-changes/{id}/feedback intelligence-delivery Governance via natural language Add rule / suppress / adjust weight in plain English POST /admin/feedback/nl-command feedback-governance Ops copilot (LLM) Diagnose system health, propose actions POST /admin/observability/copilot observability Assemble/send digest (Layer 3) Build & email the weekly digest POST /admin/weekly-digests/assemble-and-send intelligence-delivery Read detected changes Consume finished intelligence GET /admin/detected-changes intelligence-delivery

docs.title: The seven routers
docs.text:
Router variable File URL theme router app/admin/routes.py /health, competitors, sources, scan-runs intelligence_router app/admin/intelligence_routes.py scoring, agents, changes, query, digests, feedback governance observability_router app/admin/observability_routes.py /admin/observability/* policy_health_router app/admin/policy_health_routes.py /admin/policy-health/* schedule_router app/admin/schedule_routes.py source schedules scan_request_router app/admin/scan_request_routes.py manual scan requests, run visibility, audit logs news_profile_router app/admin/news_profile_routes.py news profiles + versioning

Route location correction

All routers live under app/admin/. There is no app/api/ directory — observability routes are in app/admin/observability_routes.py.

docs.title: Conventions (schemas & status codes)
docs.text:
• Request/response schemas are Pydantic models in app/schemas/admin.py (with intelligence schemas in app/schemas/intelligence.py). Field types and defaults cited on these pages come from those models.
  • _json fields. Many list/dict fields carry a _json suffix on both the model and the API (for example aliases_json, config_json, params_json). On input they accept a JSON list/object; on output they return the parsed structure.
  • Status codes. 201 Created for resource creation, 202 Accepted for background scan requests, 204 No Content for soft deletes, 404 for missing resources, 409 for conflicts (for example a schedule or news profile that already exists), 422 for invalid enum/verdict values, 400 for bad query parameters (for example an invalid group_by).

docs.title: Error format
docs.text:
The panel's apiFetch helper and the API both surface non-2xx responses as an error string of the form "<status>: <text>" — for example 404: Competitor not found. Response bodies for errors follow FastAPI's default {"detail": "..."} shape.

{ "detail": "Competitor not found" }

docs.title: Router index
docs.text:
• Competitors, Sources, Runs & Audit — core admin router + scan-request router.
  • Schedules & News Profiles — schedule router + news-profile router.
  • Intelligence & Delivery — scoring, agents, changes, query, digests, pipeline triggers.
  • Feedback Governance & Policy Health — governance endpoints + policy-health router.
  • Observability — /admin/observability/*.

docs.title: API — Schedules & News Profiles
docs.text:
This page documents the schedule router (app/admin/schedule_routes.py) and the news-profile router (app/admin/news_profile_routes.py). Schedules control when a source is due to scan; news profiles carry the rich per-competitor configuration used by the news adapter's query planner and relevance gate, with full versioning and two dry-run helpers. Schemas are in app/schemas/admin.py.

Scheduling guardrails

Enforced constants in schedule_routes.py: MIN_FREQUENCY_MINUTES = 30, MAX_QUERY_BUDGET = 20, MAX_PAGES = 50, MAX_CONCURRENT_SCANS = 10. On every create/update the route calls _compute_next_run(schedule), which sets next_run_at by schedule_type: manual → null; hourly → now + max(frequency_minutes or 60, 30) min; daily → now + 1 day; weekly → now + 7 days; cron → next fire of cron_expression via croniter (falling back to now + 24h if the expression is invalid).

docs.title: Schedules
docs.text: Each source has at most one SourceSchedule. Creating or updating a schedule computes next_run_at and writes an audit-log entry (object_type="schedule").

docs.title: News Profiles
docs.text:
A CompetitorNewsProfile is a rich, versioned configuration object for one competitor's news monitoring. Each competitor has at most one profile. Create/update/rollback all snapshot the resulting state into a ProfileVersion and write an audit entry (object_type="news_profile").

The three JSON fields below carry nested object shapes used by the query planner and relevance gate:

  • aliases_json — list[object], each item { "alias": string, "requires_context": bool, "required_context_terms": list[string] }. When requires_context is true, an alias only counts as a match if one of required_context_terms also appears.
  • brands_json — list[object], each item { "brand": string, "requires_company_context": bool, "required_terms": list[string], "active": bool }. Inactive brands are ignored; requires_company_context gates the brand on company mentions.
  • leaders_json — list[object], each item { "name": string, "role": string, "active": bool }.
  • exclusion_rules_json — list[object] of free-form rule dicts consumed by the relevance gate.
  • query_config_json — object; keys read by the planner include include_brand_queries (bool, default true), include_leader_queries (bool, default true), include_official_domain_queries (bool, default true).
  • relevance_config_json / source_trust_json — free-form object tuning dicts.

docs.text:
List every news profile across all competitors. Component: Intelligence, and Backing code: app/admin/news_profile_routes.py → list_all_news_profiles().

    "short_name": "HUL",
    "current_version": 3,
    "is_active": true
  }
]

Name Type Description competitor_id string (UUID) Competitor whose profile to fetch.

Response — 200 OK → NewsProfileOut
