docs.title: POST /admin/competitors/{competitor_id}/news-profile
docs.text:
Create the news profile for a competitor. Records version 1 (change_reason="Initial profile creation") and a create audit entry. The change_reason field is stripped from the payload before persisting the profile. Component: Intelligence, and Backing code: app/admin/news_profile_routes.py → create_news_profile().

Path parameters

Name Type Description competitor_id string (UUID) Competitor to attach the profile to.

Request body — schema NewsProfileCreate (app/schemas/admin.py)

Field Type Required Default Description display_name string | null no null Full display name. short_name string | null no null Short label. parent_company string | null no null Parent company name. tier string | null no null Priority tier label. industry string | null no null Industry classification. legal_names_json list[string] no [] Registered legal entity names. aliases_json list[object] no [] Items {alias, requires_context, required_context_terms}. brands_json list[object] no [] Items {brand, requires_company_context, required_terms, active}. primary_market string | null no null Primary market. monitored_markets_json list[string] no [] In-scope markets. excluded_markets_json list[string] no [] Suppressed markets. global_parent_policy string no "include_if_monitored_market_impacted" Global-parent handling policy. official_domains_json list[string] no [] Official domains. newsroom_urls_json list[string] no [] Newsroom URLs. investor_urls_json list[string] no [] Investor URLs. careers_urls_json list[string] no [] Careers URLs. leaders_json list[object] no [] Items {name, role, active}. industry_terms_json list[string] no [] Industry vocabulary. strategic_keywords_json list[string] no [] Strategic keywords. negative_terms_json list[string] no [] Suppression-signal terms. exclusion_rules_json list[object] no [] Free-form exclusion rules. query_config_json object no {} Query-planner toggles. relevance_config_json object no {} Relevance-gate tuning. source_trust_json object no {} Per-source trust tuning. is_active bool no true Whether the profile is active. created_by string | null no null Creator identity (used as the version's changed_by, falling back to "admin"). 
// Example request body
{
  "display_name": "Hindustan Unilever",
  "short_name": "HUL",
  "parent_company": "Unilever PLC",
  "tier": "Tier1",
  "industry": "FMCG",
  "legal_names_json": ["Hindustan Unilever Limited"],
  "aliases_json": [
    { "alias": "HUL", "requires_context": true, "required_context_terms": ["FMCG", "India"] }
  ],
  "brands_json": [
    { "brand": "Surf Excel", "requires_company_context": false, "required_terms": [], "active": true }
  ],
  "primary_market": "India",
  "monitored_markets_json": ["India"],
  "official_domains_json": ["hul.co.in"],
  "leaders_json": [
    { "name": "Rohit Jawa", "role": "CEO & Managing Director", "active": true }
  ],
  "strategic_keywords_json": ["price hike", "rural demand"],
  "is_active": true,
  "created_by": "krishna"
}

Response — 201 Created → NewsProfileOut (see field table under GET .../news-profile), with current_version = 1.

Status codes: 201 created · 404 competitor not found · 409 news profile already exists (use PATCH) · 422 validation error.

docs.title: PATCH /admin/competitors/{competitor_id}/news-profile
docs.text:
Update a competitor's news profile. Only non-null fields are applied; a new ProfileVersion is snapshotted at updated.current_version and an update audit entry with a before/after diff is written. Component: Intelligence, and Backing code: app/admin/news_profile_routes.py → update_news_profile().

Path parameters

Name Type Description competitor_id string (UUID) Competitor whose profile to update.

Request body — schema NewsProfileUpdate (app/schemas/admin.py) — all NewsProfileCreate fields are present and optional (null = leave unchanged), plus:

Field Type Required Default Description updated_by string | null no null Updater identity; used as the new version's changed_by (falls back to "admin"). change_reason string | null no null Free-text reason; stripped from the profile payload and stored as the version's change_reason in the version log.

Every other field is the optional (null-defaulted) counterpart of the matching NewsProfileCreate field above. Note created_by is not part of the update schema.

// Example request body
{
  "strategic_keywords_json": ["price hike", "rural demand", "GST"],
  "leaders_json": [
    { "name": "Rohit Jawa", "role": "CEO & Managing Director", "active": true },
    { "name": "Ritesh Tiwari", "role": "CFO", "active": true }
  ],
  "updated_by": "krishna",
  "change_reason": "Added CFO to leaders and GST keyword"
}

Response — 200 OK → NewsProfileOut (see field table under GET .../news-profile), with current_version incremented.

Status codes: 200 OK · 404 no news profile for this competitor · 422 validation error.

docs.title: DELETE /admin/competitors/{competitor_id}/news-profile
docs.text:
Delete a competitor's news profile (hard delete of the CompetitorNewsProfile row). Writes a delete audit entry before removal; existing ProfileVersion snapshots are not cascaded here. Component: Intelligence, and Backing code: app/admin/news_profile_routes.py → delete_news_profile().

Path parameters

Name Type Description competitor_id string (UUID) Competitor whose profile to delete.

Response — 204 No Content (empty body).

Status codes: 204 deleted · 404 no news profile for this competitor.

docs.title: Versioning
docs.text: Every create, update, and rollback appends a ProfileVersion snapshot. These endpoints read the version history and restore prior snapshots.

docs.title: GET /admin/competitors/{competitor_id}/news-profile/versions
docs.text:
List profile version snapshots, newest first. Component: Intelligence, and Backing code: app/admin/news_profile_routes.py → list_profile_versions().

Path parameters

Name Type Description competitor_id string (UUID) Competitor whose version history to list.

Query parameters

Name Type Required Default Description limit int no 20 Maximum number of versions to return.

Response — 200 OK → list[ProfileVersionOut]

Field Type Description id string (UUID) Version snapshot ID. competitor_id string (UUID) Owning competitor. profile_type string Always "news" for these endpoints. version_number int Sequential version number. changed_by string Identity that produced this version. change_reason string | null Reason recorded for the change. profile_json object Full snapshot of the profile at this version (all NewsProfileOut columns). is_rollback bool true if this version was produced by a rollback. created_at datetime (ISO 8601) When the snapshot was taken. 
// Example 200 response
[
  {
    "id": "c9d8e7f6-1a2b-4c3d-9e0f-5a6b7c8d9e0f",
    "competitor_id": "3a1b2c3d-4e5f-4061-8273-9a0b1c2d3e4f",
    "profile_type": "news",
    "version_number": 3,
    "changed_by": "krishna",
    "change_reason": "Added CFO to leaders and GST keyword",
    "profile_json": { "display_name": "Hindustan Unilever", "current_version": 3, "...": "..." },
    "is_rollback": false,
    "created_at": "2026-07-05T09:15:00"
  }
]

Status codes: 200 OK.

docs.title: POST /admin/competitors/{competitor_id}/news-profile/rollback/{version_id}
docs.text:
Restore the live profile to a prior version's snapshot. Snapshot keys id, competitor_id, created_at, updated_at, current_version, created_by, updated_by are skipped; the rest overwrite the live profile. A new ProfileVersion is recorded with is_rollback=true and rolled_back_from_version set, and a rollback audit entry is written. Component: Intelligence, and Backing code: app/admin/news_profile_routes.py → rollback_to_version().

Path parameters

Name Type Description competitor_id string (UUID) Competitor whose profile to roll back. version_id string (UUID) Version snapshot to restore; must belong to this competitor.

Response — 200 OK → NewsProfileOut (the restored, re-versioned profile; see field table under GET .../news-profile).

// Example 200 response
{
  "id": "7d2f9a10-4c3b-4e51-9a22-1b2c3d4e5f60",
  "competitor_id": "3a1b2c3d-4e5f-4061-8273-9a0b1c2d3e4f",
  "display_name": "Hindustan Unilever",
  "short_name": "HUL",
  "current_version": 4,
  "is_active": true,
  "updated_by": "admin",
  "updated_at": "2026-07-09T10:40:00"
}

Status codes: 200 OK · 404 version not found or not owned by this competitor, or no active profile to roll back.

docs.title: Dry-run helpers
docs.text: These read-only endpoints preview the news adapter's behavior without running a scan.

docs.title: GET /admin/competitors/{competitor_id}/news-profile/preview-queries
docs.text:
Preview the search queries the query planner would generate for a competitor. If a news profile exists, uses build_queries_from_profile; otherwise falls back to the competitor's basic fields via build_queries. Component: Intelligence, and Backing code: app/admin/news_profile_routes.py → preview_queries() (planner in app/adapters/news/query_planner.py).

Path parameters

Name Type Description competitor_id string (UUID) Competitor to preview queries for.

Query parameters

Name Type Required Default Description budget int no 10 Maximum number of queries the planner may emit.

Response — 200 OK → hand-built dict. Shape depends on whether a profile exists:

Field Type Description source enum news_profile\|competitor_fields news_profile when built from the profile; competitor_fields on fallback. profile_version int Present only when source="news_profile"; the profile's current_version. queries list[string] Generated search-query strings. count int Length of queries. 
// Example 200 response (profile present)
{
  "source": "news_profile",
  "profile_version": 3,
  "queries": [
    "Hindustan Unilever",
    "Hindustan Unilever Limited",
    "Hindustan Unilever Surf Excel",
    "Rohit Jawa Hindustan Unilever",
    "Hindustan Unilever price hike"
  ],
  "count": 5
}

// Example 200 response (fallback, no profile)
{
  "source": "competitor_fields",
  "queries": ["Hindustan Unilever", "HUL"],
  "count": 2
}

Status codes: 200 OK · 404 competitor not found (only reachable on the fallback path when the competitor itself is missing).

docs.title: POST /admin/competitors/{competitor_id}/news-profile/test-relevance
docs.text:
Run one sample article through the relevance gate and return its decision. If an active profile exists, uses profile_relevance_check; otherwise uses fast_relevance_check against the competitor's own fields and maps its verdict (strong_relevant→pass, borderline→llm_review, else suppress). Component: Feedback governance, and Backing code: app/admin/news_profile_routes.py → test_relevance() (gate in app/analysis/news/relevance.py).

Path parameters

Name Type Description competitor_id string (UUID) Competitor whose relevance rules to apply.

Request body — untyped dict; the route reads these keys:

Field Type Required Default Description title string no "" Article headline. snippet string no "" Article summary/snippet. url string no "" Article URL (used for domain checks). 
// Example request body
{
  "title": "Hindustan Unilever raises detergent prices amid rural slowdown",
  "snippet": "HUL announced a price hike across its Surf Excel range citing input costs.",
  "url": "https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/cons-products/hul-price-hike"
}

Response — 200 OK → hand-built dict.

Field Type Description decision enum pass\|suppress\|llm_review Gate outcome. reasons list[string] Human-readable reasons behind the decision. 
// Example 200 response
{
  "decision": "pass",
  "reasons": [
    "matched display_name 'Hindustan Unilever' in title",
    "matched brand 'Surf Excel' in snippet",
    "matched strategic keyword 'price hike'"
  ]
}

Status codes: 200 OK · 404 competitor not found.
